(Search-snippet content — full article 403'd on direct fetch; CNBC's own reporting language, 20 July 2026)

President Trump wrote on Truth Social over the weekend that North Sea oil will take the UK from
a "Poverty Stricken Disaster, to one of the Richest Countries anywhere in the World!" The comment
came as Trump welcomed Burnham's plan to fast-track oil and gas exploration in already-licensed
fields in the North Sea.

Andy Burnham became the UK's prime minister on Monday, 20 July 2026, succeeding Sir Keir Starmer.
Trump had earlier described Burnham as "extremely liberal" (Al Jazeera, 25 June 2026).
